en.headline: Immigration expects Sunday land-border inbound peak
en.dek: The Immigration Department forecast about 586,000 land-border arrivals today, the busiest inbound day in its Golden Week plan.
body: The Immigration Department expects Sunday to be the busiest day for land-border arrivals during the National Day Golden Week, with about 586,000 people coming in by land.

The festival arrangements working group, led by the Chief Secretary, said in late September that about 7.44 million people, residents and visitors together, were expected to cross Hong Kong's sea, land and air controls between 1 and 7 October. About 6.31 million of those trips were forecast on land. Saturday was tipped as the outbound peak, at about 587,000 departures.

Lo Wu, the Lok Ma Chau Spur Line and Shenzhen Bay were expected to be the busiest controls, with daily averages of about 220,000, 190,000 and 150,000 crossings. The department said it had opened extra counters, temporary counters and vehicle kiosks, cut frontline leave, and set up a joint command centre at Lo Wu with police, customs and the MTR Corporation.

About 800 e-channels are in place across the controls. At the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge departure hall, registered permanent residents can use a contactless lane that checks them by facial recognition without stopping to show an identity card.

zh.headline: 入境處料周日為陸路入境高峰
zh.dek: 入境處預計今日陸路入境約58.6萬人次，是國慶黃金周計劃中最繁忙的入境日。
body: 入境事務處預計，今日是內地國慶黃金周陸路入境最繁忙的一天，經陸路入境約58.6萬人次。
由政務司司長領導的節慶安排跨部門工作小組九月底表示，10月1日至7日經本港海、陸、空管制站進出的人次預計約744萬，包括香港居民及訪客，其中約631萬經陸路。小組當時亦預計周六為陸路出境高峰，出境約58.7萬人次。
羅湖、落馬洲支線及深圳灣管制站料最繁忙，每日平均分別約22萬、19萬及15萬人次。入境處表示已加開檢查櫃枱、臨時櫃枱及車輛檢查亭，並減少前線休假，以便調配人手；又聯同警方、海關及港鐵在羅湖設立聯合指揮中心。
各管制站約有800條e-道。港珠澳大橋香港口岸離境大堂設有無感e-道，已登記的合資格香港永久性居民可透過容貌識別完成出境檢查，毋須停步出示身份證。
